consumer_unavailable_reason.description: Selected consumer mode readiness reason; null when enabled. Readiness is not production account or provider acceptance evidence.

password_staff_roles.description: Present for enabled server-configured staff rosters or scoped Admin password-only mode. Role categories only; no username, staff ID or credentials. Old servers/default empty rosters omit this descriptor. Does not grant authority or verify a real person/MFA.

post.description: Configured password staff login. Body cannot choose role. Optional named-roster mfa_required returns only a short-lived MFA challenge; no session exists before successful TOTP. Default and legacy administrator/reviewer login retain the existing session shape. In explicit first_party mode, the named configured identity must already resolve to a matching active physical staff user. Missing enrollment returns FIRST_PARTY_STAFF_BINDING_REQUIRED; Logto-managed ownership returns ACCOUNT_MIGRATION_REQUIRED. This route never bootstraps or migrates a staff user in that mode.

Complete the current server-bound password challenge with a six-digit TOTP. Atomic single use, seed replay watermark, expiry and account quota apply. Current role/credential/MFA generation is rechecked; no password-only fallback. Restore seed-rotation guard returns503.
Invalidate the supplied server-bound pending MFA challenge. Idempotent generic response; does not create a session.

post.summary: Reprocess ready episode media from its retained source
post.description: Administrator only, using the configured local/test media adapter. The series must be draft and the episode must have ready media backed by its current completed upload. The source checksum is server-owned and is not accepted in the request. The server physically verifies the retained source and checksum, then locks and revalidates the current upload and version bindings before enqueueing. The stable Idempotency-Key is scoped to the administrator: replaying the same normalized payload returns the same job and its current status; a changed payload conflicts. Both fresh 202 responses and idempotent replays return series_version and media_version as the exact accepted request values (the input snapshot), never the queued or latest versions. upload_id retains the accepted current_upload_id binding. Enqueue advances the database series version by one and worker completion advances the media version by one; refresh the existing series/episode representation to obtain current values. This action neither publishes content nor changes worker behavior, database schema, privileges or third-party adapter configuration.

202.description: Accepted. A fresh job is pending; a replay returns the same job with its current status. In both cases, series_version and media_version are the exact accepted input values, not queued or latest values.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: the header or strict request body is invalid.

403.description: The authenticated role is not authorized to reprocess media.

409.description: The current draft, ready-media, version, upload, source, replacement, subtitle or idempotency binding prevents reprocessing.

503.description: The retained source or configured media adapter is unavailable.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable administrator-scoped key for this exact normalized request; reuse with different payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

reason.description: The server trims this operator reason before validating its 3–500 character length, auditing it and binding the normalized idempotency payload.

current_upload_id.description: Expected current completed upload binding; source checksums remain server-owned.

post.description: Managed first-party account only, authorized by its current password challenge and bound request identity. Confirmed or expired enrollment is refused. TOTP verification uses the existing /auth/admin/mfa endpoint; no business session exists before confirmation.

allOf.description: Authorized Admin-only private registry; never part of the public Series schema.

AiProvenanceCapability.description: Fixed public write capability only; no private provenance. Clients require exact supported values; missing/unknown capability disables registration and AI-purpose evidence uploads.

source.description: Private documentary claim only, never verified reviewer identity or approval.

AiProvenanceDraft.description: Private draft registry only. Presence, including empty lists, blocks submit and publish. Scope never changes content_origin or grants permissions. Null/removal, client approval and reviewer IDs are unsupported.

AiProvenanceEvidenceReference.description: Private same-series ready evidence file and exact immutable document version. No URLs or synthetic fixture references.

EffectiveAgePolicy.description: Independent optional local gates. Missing stored optional flags default to false/false; malformed stored configuration fails closed with503. Existing saved booleans are retained. Neither switch enables a production adapter or bypasses the mandatory A-rated adult declaration, rights, entitlement or session checks.

purpose.description: Optional evidence purpose; omitted legacy files use rights. AI-purpose completion preserves the current rights evidence/license while resetting approval.

self_migration_enabled.description: True only while Logto remains selected, its configured resource-token verifier is available, and the default-disabled FIRST_PARTY_SELF_MIGRATION_ENABLED staging gate is explicitly enabled. Missing means false. This does not activate first-party login or migrate staff.

staff_self_migration_enabled.description: Default false. Enables only authenticated Logto staff migration preparation with current API-verified MFA and the dedicated configured encryption key. It does not switch authentication mode or admit Logto-only sessions without API MFA.

phone_login_enabled.description: Default false. Requires explicit first_party mode and protected server-side SMS configuration. Submission acceptance is not authentication or delivery confirmation. Missing means disabled.

whatsapp_login_enabled.description: Default false. Requires an explicitly enabled protected WhatsApp Business configuration and an operator-declared approved authentication template. This flag does not establish real provider delivery or verification.

FirstPartyCapability.description: Available only for explicit first_party mode. This does not confirm an existing staff binding, enable payments or migrate any external identity.

FirstPartyStaffEnrollment.description: Only the unexpired password challenge for this same managed account may obtain its unconfirmed seed; sent with Cache-Control:no-store. Never listed or returned to another administrator.

allowed_uses.description: offline_download records an explicit licensing claim subject to the existing independent content review. Its absence does not grant download rights. This declaration does not enable or authorize offline downloading.

refresh_token.description: The existing rotating internal business refresh credential, distinct from any Logto refresh token.

expires_at.description: Expiry of this internal access credential; direct staff authority is additionally bounded by staff_authorization.proof_expires_at.

refresh_expires_at.description: Expiry of the internal refresh credential. Direct API TOTP preserves the original MFA freshness deadline; direct Logto-only preserves the original business family creation time plus 15 minutes. Neither deadline slides on renewal.

app_id.description: Viewer SPA application ID, or null when Viewer authentication is not configured. An Admin-only deployment keeps this null and scopes empty; employee login uses staff_app_id and staff_scopes independently.

scopes.description: Viewer exchange scopes only. Empty when the Viewer application is not configured; this does not disable an explicitly available direct staff application or its separate complete staff_scopes.

staff_step_up.description: existing_password_totp retains legacy employee step-up; api_totp belongs only to direct_api_totp; none belongs only to explicitly selected direct_logto_only and does not assert verified MFA.

staff_mode.description: Optional on older providers. Selected server authentication authority, distinct from staff_enabled availability. Direct configuration selects direct_api_totp or direct_logto_only explicitly and retains that mode even when all named staff rows are disabled; it never falls back to password authority.

staff_app_id.description: The independent Admin SPA public application ID when a staff login is available; null when staff_enabled is false. Never substitute the Viewer app_id.

staff_scopes.description: Exact business API scopes for direct staff role bundles. These are separate from Viewer session:exchange. An SDK still requests its OIDC and offline scopes; wildcard scopes grant no authority. Current finite registry has 24 unique business scopes including session:exchange; complete bundles are defined by LogtoStaffRole policy, not wildcards. Empty when staff_enabled is false; this does not change the configured direct staff authority or permit password fallback.

staff_mfa.description: api_totp is advertised only for direct_api_totp, including when all named staff rows are disabled. direct_logto_only advertises null together with staff_step_up none; its business session truthfully has mfa_verified false. No client-supplied MFA result grants authority.

staff_proof_max_age_seconds.description: Maximum direct staff authorization lease measured from the signed resource access token iat, never from exchange or refresh time.

permissions.description: Effective permissions in the one active complete role bundle, derived and revalidated by the API. Logto roles, client claims and partial bundles do not grant business authority.

proof_expires_at.description: End of this active business authorization lease, bounded by resource proof exp and iat + configured staff proof maximum age.

mfa_authenticated_at.description: Time the API accepted TOTP. Refresh never advances this timestamp; the staff MFA freshness window is 15 minutes.

permissions.description: Effective permissions in the one active complete role bundle, derived and revalidated by the API. Logto roles, client claims and partial bundles do not grant business authority.

proof_expires_at.description: End of the current Logto-only access authorization lease: no later than resource proof exp, signed iat plus the configured 30-300 second maximum, or the original internal business family creation time plus 15 minutes.

mfa_authenticated_at.description: No API MFA was completed in Logto-only mode. This value is always null; the API does not manufacture an MFA time from Logto claims or a session creation time.

LogtoStaffAuthorization.description: Mode-discriminated server authorization. Existing direct_api_totp retains its verified MFA fact and timestamp unchanged. Explicit direct_logto_only uses mfa_verified false and mfa_authenticated_at null; roles and complete permissions remain server-verified in both modes.

LogtoStaffRole.description: One active server-validated business role. The Admin application identity is not itself the admin business role.

MemberWindow.description: Optional series-wide member window. Missing or standard preserves free/paid episode rules. Exclusive and pre-public early access require a current verified source granting both catalog and exclusive content; after public_at, existing episode rules apply. Publication requires subscription rights.

source_url.description: Public HTTPS source; no credentials, query, fragment, custom port or local/private literal IP.

license_url.description: Public HTTPS licence URL; no credentials, query, fragment or custom port.

free_episode_count.description: Number of leading free episodes; publication still requires this count not exceed the actual episode count.

content_format.description: Explicit narrative format. unknown preserves unclassified legacy records; no inference from duration, language, content_origin or episode count.

content_collections.description: Editorial collection. India Launch requires explicitly classified micro_series; never grants region, language, age, publication or monetization rights.

enrollment_required.description: Present only for managed first-party staff; true requires enrollment through the current password challenge before a business session can exist.

roles.description: Optional direct-staff projection: exactly the current active business role, consistent with role. It is not a list of self-selected or Console roles.

permissions.description: Effective permissions in the one active complete role bundle, derived and revalidated by the API. Logto roles, client claims and partial bundles do not grant business authority.

ViewerBetterAuthCapability.description: Present when the server enables the same-origin Viewer authentication entry point. Does not change the authentication mode of other applications.

native_social_providers.description: Optional, present only when the server-side native social feature is explicitly enabled; absence means disabled. Advertised provider configuration is not real-device or provider acceptance.

existing_account_recovery_enabled.description: Always false: the Logto signed-resource recovery purpose has been retired. This is not a global Web recovery switch: first-party username recovery independently requires identity_mode=first_party, first_party.enabled/password_login_enabled and both consumer global flags; binding still requires existing_account_migration_enabled and both fresh ownership proofs.
